rows.source_ko: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this ruleis to prescribe matters delegated by the Horse Industry Promotion Act and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act , and matters necessary for the implementation thereof.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Horse Industry Promotion Act and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, and matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: Article 2 (Horse Registration Agency) ①The horse registration agency pursuant to Article 7, Paragraph 1 of the “Horse Industry Promotion Act” (hereinafter referred to as the “Act” ) shall be the Korea Racing Authority pursuant to the “Korea Racing Authority Act” (hereinafter referred to as the “RA”).
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Horse Registration Agency) ①The horse registration agency pursuant to Article 7, Paragraph 1 of the “Horse Industry Promotion Act” (hereinafter referred to as the “Act” ) shall be the Korea Racing Authority pursuant to the “Korea Racing Authority Act” (hereinafter referred to as the “RA”).

rows.source_ko: ② Deleted <2017. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: ② Deleted <2017. 1. 2.>

rows.source_ko: ③ Detailed matters regarding the registration of horses shall be determined by the Korea Racing Authority and announced on the Authority's website.
rows.text_en: ③ Detailed matters regarding the registration of horses shall be determined by the Korea Racing Authority and announced on the Authority's website.

rows.source_ko: Article 3 (Designation of Professional Training Institutions, etc.) ① Deleted <January 2, 2017>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Designation of Professional Training Institutions, etc.) ① Deleted <January 2, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ② Any person who intends to be designated as a professional personnel training institution pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit to the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs an application for designation as a professional personnel training institution in the form of Annex No. 1 , attaching the documents set forth in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013>
rows.text_en: ② Any person who intends to be designated as a professional personnel training institution pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit to the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs an application for designation as a professional personnel training institution in the form of Annex No. 1 , attaching the documents set forth in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 1. Education plan including curriculum and educational content
rows.text_en: 1. Education plan including curriculum and educational content

rows.source_ko: 2. Data on the current status of educational facilities and equipment
rows.text_en: 2. Data on the current status of educational facilities and equipment

rows.source_ko: 3. Documents regarding the current status of faculty recruitment
rows.text_en: 3. Documents regarding the current status of faculty recruitment

rows.source_ko: 4. Operating Expense Financing Plan
rows.text_en: 4. Operating Expense Financing Plan

rows.source_ko: ③ Upon receiving an application for designation of a professional personnel training institution pursuant to Paragraph 2, the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs may designate such institution after considering the matters in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; July 21, 2015>
rows.text_en: ③ Upon receiving an application for designation of a professional personnel training institution pursuant to Paragraph 2, the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs may designate such institution after considering the matters in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; July 21, 2015>

rows.source_ko: 1. The curriculum and educational content must be appropriate.
rows.text_en: 1. The curriculum and educational content must be appropriate.

rows.source_ko: 2. Must adequately possess educational facilities and equipment.
rows.text_en: 2. Must adequately possess educational facilities and equipment.

rows.source_ko: 3. The expertise of the teaching staff must be ensured.
rows.text_en: 3. The expertise of the teaching staff must be ensured.

rows.source_ko: 4. The operating expense financing plan must be feasible.
rows.text_en: 4. The operating expense financing plan must be feasible.

rows.source_ko: ④ In the event that the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs designates a professional personnel training institution pursuant to Paragraph 3, the Minister shall issue a Certificate of Designation as a Professional Personnel Training Institution in the form of Annex 2 to the applicant and publicize the matters set forth in each of the following subparagraphs on the internet homepage of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs. <Newly added July 21, 2015>
rows.text_en: ④ In the event that the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs designates a professional personnel training institution pursuant to Paragraph 3, the Minister shall issue a Certificate of Designation as a Professional Personnel Training Institution in the form of Annex 2 to the applicant and publicize the matters set forth in each of the following subparagraphs on the internet homepage of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs. <Newly added July 21, 2015>

rows.source_ko: 1. Designation Number and Designation Date
rows.text_en: 1. Designation Number and Designation Date

rows.source_ko: 2. Name and location of the training institution
rows.text_en: 2. Name and location of the training institution

rows.source_ko: 3. Name of the representative of the training institution
rows.text_en: 3. Name of the representative of the training institution

rows.source_ko: 4. Training Course
rows.text_en: 4. Training Course

rows.source_ko: ⑤ The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs may provide full or partial support for the expenses set forth in each of the following subparagraphs to specialized personnel training institutions designated pursuant to Paragraph 3. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; July 21, 2015>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs may provide full or partial support for the expenses set forth in each of the following subparagraphs to specialized personnel training institutions designated pursuant to Paragraph 3. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; July 21, 2015>

rows.source_ko: 1. Expenses necessary for operating professional training programs and for surveys and research
rows.text_en: 1. Expenses necessary for operating professional training programs and for surveys and research

rows.source_ko: 2. Expenses related to training materials and practical equipment
rows.text_en: 2. Expenses related to training materials and practical equipment

rows.source_ko: 3. Expenses for the installation or use of educational facilities, or renovation and repair
rows.text_en: 3. Expenses for the installation or use of educational facilities, or renovation and repair

rows.source_ko: 4. Other expenses necessary for training specialized personnel
rows.text_en: 4. Other expenses necessary for training specialized personnel

rows.source_ko: ⑥ The criteria for the revocation of designation and suspension of operations of professional personnel training institutions pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 2 of the Act are as set forth in Attached Table 1. <Newly added July 21, 2015>
rows.text_en: ⑥ The criteria for the revocation of designation and suspension of operations of professional personnel training institutions pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 2 of the Act are as set forth in Attached Table 1. <Newly added July 21, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ⑦ In the event that the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs revokes the designation or suspends the operations of a professional personnel training institution pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 2 of the Act , he/she shall conduct a hearing pursuant to Article 27 of the Act and announce the results without delay on the internet homepage of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs. <Newly added July 21, 2015>
rows.text_en: ⑦ In the event that the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs revokes the designation or suspends the operations of a professional personnel training institution pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 2 of the Act , he/she shall conduct a hearing pursuant to Article 27 of the Act and announce the results without delay on the internet homepage of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs. <Newly added July 21, 2015>

rows.source_ko: Article 4 (Qualifications related to the horse industry) The qualifications for horse trainers, farriers, or therapeutic riding instructors pursuant to Article 5 of the Enforcement Decree of the Horse Industry Promotion Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”)shall be in accordance with Form No. 3 , Form No. 4 , or Form No. 5, respectively.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Qualifications related to the horse industry) The qualifications for horse trainers, farriers, or therapeutic riding instructors pursuant to Article 5 of the Enforcement Decree of the Horse Industry Promotion Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”)shall be in accordance with Form No. 3 , Form No. 4 , or Form No. 5, respectively.

rows.source_ko: 제5조(마약 및 향정신성의약품 중독자) 법 제13조제1항제3호에서 “농림축산식품부령으로 정하는 사람”이란 의사의 진단 결과 마약ㆍ대마(大麻) 또는 향정신성의약품 중독자로 판명되어 말조련 등의 직무를 수행하기에 부적합한 사람을 말한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2017. 1. 2., 2019. 11. 14.>
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Addicts to Narcotics and Psychotropic Drugs) In Article 13, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 3 of the Act , the term “person prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs” refers to a person who is found to be an addict to narcotics, cannabis, or psychotropic drugs as a result of a physician’s diagnosis and is deemed unfit to perform duties such as horse training. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Jan. 2, 2017; Nov. 14, 2019>

rows.source_ko: 제6조(말조련사 등의 행정처분) 법 제13조제3항에 따른 말조련사, 장제사 또는 재활승마지도사의 자격에 대한 행정처분의 기준은 별표 1의2와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Administrative Dispositions on Horse Trainers, etc.) The standards for administrative dispositions regarding the qualifications of horse trainers, farriers, or therapeutic riding instructors pursuant to Article 13, Paragraph 3 of the Act are as set forth in Appendix 1-2 .
[Wholly Amended July 21, 2015]

rows.source_ko: 제7조(농어촌형 승마시설 신고서) 영 제6조제1항에 따른 농어촌형 승마시설(이하 “승마시설”이라 한다) 신고서(변경신고서)는 별지 제6호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Report Form for Rural-type Equestrian Facilities) The report form (change report form) for rural-type equestrian facilities (hereinafter referred to as “equestrian facilities”) pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of Annex 6 .

rows.source_ko: 제8조(승마시설 신고대장) 영 제6조제2항에 따른 승마시설 신고대장은 별지 제7호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Report Register of Equestrian Facilities) The report register of equestrian facilities pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of Annex 7 .

rows.source_ko: 제9조(승마시설 신고확인증) 영 제6조제2항에 따른 승마시설 신고확인증은 별지 제8호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Certificate of Reporting of Equestrian Facility) The certificate of reporting of equestrian facility pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of Annex 8 .

rows.source_ko: 제10조(승마시설 신고확인증 재발급신청서) 영 제6조제3항에 따른 승마시설 신고확인증 재발급신청서는 별지 제9호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Application for Reissuance of Certificate of Reporting of Equestrian Facility) The application for reissuance of the Certificate of Reporting of Equestrian Facility pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree is as in Form No. 9 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: 제11조(승마시설의 시설 및 안전기준 등) 법 제15조제2항에 따라 승마시설 운영자가 지켜야 하는 시설 및 안전기준은 별표 2와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Facility and Safety Standards, etc. for Equestrian Facilities) The facility and safety standards that an operator of an equestrian facility must observe pursuant to Article 15, Paragraph 2 of the Act are as set forth in Attached Table 2 .

rows.source_ko: 제12조(승마시설 운영자에 대한 영업취소 등 기준) 법 제15조제5항에 따른 승마시설 운영자에 대한 영업취소 및 영업정지의 기준은 별표 3과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Criteria for cancellation of business, etc. for equestrian facility operators) The criteria for cancellation of business and suspension of business for equestrian facility operators pursuant to Article 15, Paragraph 5 of the Act are as set forth in Attached Table 3 .

rows.source_ko: 제13조(말산업의 매출규모) 영 제10조제3호에서 “농림축산식품부령으로 정하는 규모”란 20억원을 말한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: Article 13 (Sales Scale of the Horse Industry) In Article 10, Subparagraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree , the term “scale prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs” refers to 2 billion won. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 제14조(말산업특구 지정신청서) 영 제11조제1항에 따른 말산업특구 지정신청서(면적변경신청서)는 별지 제10호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 14 (Application for Designation of Special Horse Industry Zone) The application for designation of a special horse industry zone (application for change of area) pursuant to Article 11 , Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 10 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: 제15조(보고ㆍ검사) ① 농림축산식품부장관은 법 제26조제1항에 따라 해당 지방자치단체의장 및 전담기관의 장에게 보고를 요구할 때에는 7일 이상의 기간을 주어야 한다. 다만 긴급한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하다. <개정 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: Article 15 (Reporting and Inspection) ① When the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs requests a report from the head of a relevant local government and the head of a specialized agency pursuant to Article 26, Paragraph 1 of the Act , he/she shall grant a period of at least seven days. However, this shall not apply in urgent cases. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ② 농림축산식품부장관과 지방자치단체의 장은 법 제26조제2항에 따라 말사업자에게 보고 또는 자료 제출을 요구하는 때에는 자료의 내용, 제출기한 등을 구체적으로 밝힌 서면으로 하여야 한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: ② When the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs and the head of a local government request a horse business operator to submit a report or data pursuant to Article 26, Paragraph 2 of the Act , they shall do so in writing, specifying in detail the contents of the data, the deadline for submission, etc. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ③ 법 제26조제2항에 따라 검사를 하려는 관계 공무원은 말사업자에게 검사일시와 검사내용 등 검사에 필요한 사항을 미리 알려주어야 한다. 다만, 긴급히 검사하여야 하거나 미리 알려 줄 경우 그 목적을 달성할 수 없다고 인정되는 경우에는 그러하지 아니한다.
rows.text_en: ③ Any public official intending to conduct an inspection pursuant to Article 26, Paragraph 2 of the Act shall notify the horse business operator in advance of matters necessary for the inspection, such as the date and time of the inspection and the contents of the inspection. However, this shall not apply in cases where an inspection must be conducted urgently or where it is deemed that the purpose cannot be achieved if notification is given in advance.

rows.source_ko: 제16조(규제의 재검토) 농림축산식품부장관은 제5조에 따른 마약 및 향정신성의약품 중독자의 기준에 대하여 2017년 1월 1일을 기준으로 3년마다(매 3년이 되는 해의 기준일과 같은 날 전까지를 말한다) 그 타당성을 검토하여 개선 등의 조치를 하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 16 (Review of Regulations) The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs shall review the validity of the standards for addicts of narcotics and psychotropic drugs under Article 5 every three years starting from January 1, 2017 (meaning until the day before the same date as the standard date of every third year) and take measures such as improvement.
[Wholly revised Jan. 2, 2017]
